Please do not replace Wookieepedia pages with blank content. Blank pages are harmful to Wookieepedia because they have a tendency to confuse readers. If it is a duplicate article, please [[w:c:community:Help:Redirects|redirect]] it to an appropriate existing page. If the page has been [[Wookieepedia:User conduct policy#Vandalism|vandalized]], please [[w:c:community:Help:Reverting|revert]] it to the last legitimate version. If you feel that the content of a page is inappropriate, please [[w:c:community:Help:Editing|edit]] the page and replace it with appropriate content. If you believe there is no hope for the page, please see the [[Wookieepedia:Deletion policy|deletion policy]] for how to proceed. Thanks for contributing to Wookieepedia, the ''Star Wars'' wiki!<!--Template:Blanking--><noinclude>
